Run Crash-Resumable, Schema-Enforced Batch Extraction Over a Data Frame

Source: R/extract.R
airgap_extract.Rd

Processes text rows in an R data frame through a local air-gapped LLM runtime into a strictly typed tibble with:

  1. Pre-flight air-gap isolation verification (preflight_isolation_check()),

  2. Mandatory pre-inference PII redaction or keyed HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymization (or explicit "verified_deidentified" attestation),

  3. Strict JSON schema validation (validate_extraction()) with automatic structured repair retries (build_repair_prompt()),

  4. Crash-resumable atomic per-row JSONL checkpointing (never storing raw input text), and

  5. Optional automatic hash-chained PII-free IRB/HIPAA audit logging (audit_log_append()).

Usage

airgap_extract(
  data,
  text_col,
  schema,
  runtime,
  prompt_template = NULL,
  id_col = NULL,
  pii_policy = c("redact", "pseudonymize", "verified_deidentified"),
  pii_config = NULL,
  pii_key = NULL,
  vault = NULL,
  vault_path = NULL,
  encrypt_vault = TRUE,
  reidentify_output = FALSE,
  checkpoint_path = NULL,
  resume = TRUE,
  retry_failed = FALSE,
  max_retries = 2L,
  container_spec = NULL,
  model_path = NULL,
  allow_internal_network = FALSE,
  strict_proxy = TRUE,
  output_pii_action = c("redact", "error", "warn", "none"),
  audit_log_path = NULL,
  run_id = NULL,
  progress = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing input text rows.

text_col

Character scalar name of the text column in data.

schema

An extraction_schema() object defining output column types and constraints.

runtime

A local air-gapped runtime created by runtime_ollama(), runtime_openai_local(), or runtime_mock().

prompt_template

Optional character scalar prompt template containing "{text}". Defaults to a strict JSON schema extraction prompt.

id_col

Optional character scalar column name in data supplying unique non-NA row identifiers. If NULL, synthesizes .row_id as "1", "2", ..., "N".

pii_policy

Character scalar pre-inference privacy policy: "redact" (default), "pseudonymize", or "verified_deidentified".

pii_config

Optional pii_config() object used when pii_policy is "redact" or "pseudonymize". Defaults to pii_config().

pii_key

Secret key (e.g., from pii_vault_key()) required when pii_policy = "pseudonymize".

vault

Optional existing airgap_pii_vault to accumulate mappings when pii_policy = "pseudonymize".

vault_path

Optional path to persist the separate encrypted PII vault when pii_policy = "pseudonymize".

encrypt_vault

Logical scalar; encrypt saved vault file. Defaults to TRUE.

reidentify_output

Logical scalar; if TRUE and pii_policy = "pseudonymize", locally re-identifies character output columns using the vault after inference. Defaults to FALSE.

checkpoint_path

Optional path to an atomic JSONL checkpoint file enabling crash-resumable execution across interruptions.

resume

Logical scalar; if TRUE (default) and checkpoint_path exists, skips rows already committed in the checkpoint. If FALSE, starts a fresh checkpoint file (overwriting any existing file at checkpoint_path).

retry_failed

Logical scalar; when resuming from a checkpoint, whether to re-attempt rows previously recorded with .status == "failed". Defaults to FALSE.

max_retries

Non-negative integer maximum structured repair retries after an initial invalid generation. Defaults to 2L.

container_spec

Optional airgap_container_spec() verified in pre-flight and recorded in the run manifest/audit trail. Defaults to runtime$container_spec.

model_path

Optional path to local model weights verified against container_spec$model_digest or runtime$model_digest during pre-flight.

allow_internal_network

Logical scalar passed to preflight_isolation_check(). Defaults to FALSE.

strict_proxy

Logical scalar passed to preflight_isolation_check() controlling whether unbypassed outbound proxy env vars fail closed. Defaults to TRUE.

output_pii_action

Character scalar controlling post-inference PII leakage scanning of generated character schema fields (defending against prompt-injected or memorized PII echo): "redact" (default, scrubs leaked PII before checkpointing/returning), "error" (aborts with airgap_output_pii_error), "warn", or "none". Automatically skipped when pii_policy = "verified_deidentified" unless explicitly requested.

audit_log_path

Optional path to an immutable hash-chained JSONL audit log appended via audit_log_append().

run_id

Optional character scalar run identifier. Defaults to an auto-generated UTC run ID.

progress

Logical scalar; emit brief CLI progress summary. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble of class c("airgap_extraction", "tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame") containing the row ID column, strictly typed schema columns, and per-row metadata (.status, .attempts, .error, .elapsed_ms). Attachable provenance objects are accessed via extraction_manifest(), extraction_privacy_report(), extraction_preflight(), extraction_vault(), and extraction_throughput().

Examples

df <- tibble::tibble(
  note_id = c("N1", "N2"),
  note_text = c(
    "Dr. Jane Doe (MRN: 102938) reports mild anxiety, sleep improved.",
    "Email bob@example.org for scheduling; mood stable."
  )
)
sc <- extraction_schema(
  severity = schema_field("enum", values = c("mild", "moderate", "severe")),
  score = schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 10L)
)
res <- airgap_extract(df, "note_text", sc, runtime_mock(), id_col = "note_id")
res
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   note_id severity score .status .attempts .error .elapsed_ms
#>   <chr>   <chr>    <int> <chr>       <int> <chr>        <dbl>
#> 1 N1      severe      10 ok              1 NA               2
#> 2 N2      mild         2 ok              1 NA               1
